text_en: When visiting President Ho Chi Minh's Mausoleum, which dress code shows respect for the nation's beloved father?

choices_en.text: Modest clothing, pants covering the knees, polite shirts with sleeves.
Wearing shorts and tank tops for comfort and coolness.
Wearing a short, see-through, fashionable runway-style dress.

text_en: In the 'dạm ngõ' (pre-engagement) ceremony, if the groom's family prepares the offering trays but lacks betel leaves and areca nuts, how would it be viewed in wedding culture?

choices_en.text: A serious omission, disrespecting the traditional ritual where betel is the start of conversation.
Modern, progressive, knowing how to omit unnecessary cumbersome procedures.
Smart because it saves money on buying betel and areca.

text_en: The Vietnamese habit of leaving a small space in the middle of the meal tray for a shared fish sauce bowl reflects which cultural philosophy?

choices_en.text: Community spirit, solidarity, sharing, and equality among family members during the meal.
Because the tray is too small to place individual bowls.
To save fish sauce, so people don't eat too much.

text_en: You are invited to attend the new rice offering ceremony of ethnic minorities in the Northwest region. Which action shows respect for their culture?

choices_en.text: Listening to the village elder perform the ceremony and respectfully enjoying local products.
Complaining about the strange food and asking the host to cook instant noodles for you.
Freely walking around the offering table to record short video clips for TikTok.

text_en: When you see a friend in trouble and decide with your class to collect money to help, which cultural tradition are you promoting?

choices_en.text: Good leaves cover torn leaves (helping those in need), Love others as you love yourself.
Each house's light shines for itself (everyone for themselves), whoever is in trouble deals with it.
If you work hard, you will succeed one day.

text_en: An architect wants to design a modern house but with the spirit of Northern Vietnamese culture. Which of the following elements could be creatively applied?

choices_en.text: Using a sloping red tiled roof system, a wide porch, and rustic ceramic bricks
Building a tall, pointed spire in the style of a French Gothic church
Using large tempered glass walls and painting the walls neon colors

text_en: Why do Vietnamese people have the custom of eating fermented glutinous rice and sour fruits (plums, lychees) right after waking up on the Doan Ngo Festival (5th day of the 5th lunar month)?

choices_en.text: According to folklore, the sour and astringent taste and the alcohol help kill insects (parasites) in the body
To help the body gain weight quickly after a long night's sleep
Because these are the only foods available in the market on this day

text_en: When you want to criticize a mistake made by a Vietnamese subordinate, which approach is the most subtle and culturally appropriate?

choices_en.text: Talk to them privately and gently, praise their strengths first, then point out their weaknesses for them to correct
Criticize them harshly and scold them in front of the entire company meeting to set an example
Stay silent but secretly deduct their salary at the end of the month

text_en: Besides entertainment, what does the traditional folk game of Kite Flying in Vietnamese rural areas also symbolize?

choices_en.text: Praying for favorable winds, sending human wishes to heaven and earth
A game to compete and see which family is rich enough to own a bigger kite
To scare away birds that destroy people's crops

text_en: When you travel to Sa Pa and a local person invites you to buy a brocade souvenir, if you don't want to buy it, what is the most polite way to refuse?

choices_en.text: Smile, bow slightly, and friendly say "Thank you, I'm just looking."
Wave your hands continuously, frown, and say "No, I'm not buying, it's fake!" then leave
Ignore them as if they don't exist and walk past them

text_en: The practice of maintaining the worship of the God of Wealth - Earth God in current business establishments reflects what desire in the cultural mindset of commerce?

choices_en.text: Praying for stable land, good business, and many customers coming and going
Extorting and intimidating competitors around the store
To beautify the storefront space of the business

text_en: You are assigned to write a foreword for a book about the Art of Don ca tai tu Nam Bo. Which phrase best captures the spirit of this art form?

choices_en.text: Folk music art that is improvisational, generous, and appreciative of the people of the South
A solemn, academic court music form that must be strictly adhered to
A grand theatrical musical genre that uses many modern electronic instruments

text_en: When eating Vietnamese rolled dishes (like pho cuon, goi cuon), what does neatly arranging herbs, meat, and shrimp into rice paper and rolling it tightly show?

choices_en.text: The sophistication and skill of the hands and the philosophy of yin and yang harmony in the dish
Because it must be done this way so the food doesn't spoil
Because if it's not rolled tightly, the owner will fine you extra

choices_en.text: In communication, when a Vietnamese person says "Let me check again," how should you understand this situation according to the culture of harmonious behavior?
It is often a subtle, delicate refusal to avoid directly disappointing you
They will definitely agree with you, they just need a few more minutes to think
They are showing contempt and don't care about what you said

text_en: A fashion brand wants to launch a collection inspired by Dong Ho folk paintings. Which of the following images, if incorporated into the design, would bring joy and prosperity?

choices_en.text: The image of a baby hugging a chicken or a mouse wedding
The image of a jealousy fight or a toad scholar
The image of Lady Trieu riding an elephant or the Trung Sisters

text_en: When you go to a groundbreaking ceremony and see people performing a land-worshipping ritual, what is the cultural meaning behind it?

choices_en.text: To ask permission from the Spirits and Earth God of that place to build, and to pray for safety for the workers
To put on a show for taking pictures to report to the authorities
A mandatory ritual to get a construction permit

text_en: Why do Vietnamese people usually not fill the teacup to the brim when pouring tea for guests, but only pour about 2/3 of the cup?

choices_en.text: To avoid making the guest's hand hot when holding it and to show politeness (full wine, less tea)
Because the host wants to save tea for later guests
Because a full teacup would bring bad luck to the host's family

text_en: When you visit a friend's house in the Mekong Delta and they treat you to 'Lẩu mắm' (fermented fish hotpot), which action shows that you know how to enjoy the local culinary culture?

choices_en.text: Eating it with many kinds of wild vegetables (water lily, sesbania flower, bitter herb) and praising its rich flavor
Complaining that the fish sauce smell is too strong and asking the host to buy Thai hotpot broth instead
Only picking out the fish and meat to eat, leaving all the broth and vegetables behind

text_en: When schools organize a 'Bánh chưng' (sticky rice cake) wrapping contest for students during Tet, which cultural education method are they applying?

choices_en.text: Learning by doing, helping students gain practical experience and preserve traditional customs
Creating a playground for classes to compete and fight for prizes at all costs
Finding students with a talent for wrapping cakes to pursue it as a career later

text_en: A foreign tourist accidentally stood with their back to the main altar in a communal house to take a picture. How should you act to help them understand the culture?

choices_en.text: Gently remind them in English that turning their back to the altar is disrespectful
Shout at them loudly and ask security to kick them out of the relic site immediately
Ignore it as if you didn't see it because they are foreigners and don't know anything

choices_en.text: Unity in diversity, respecting and promoting the unique identity of all 54 ethnic groups
Complete assimilation, making the cultures of ethnic minorities exactly like the Kinh ethnic group
Separate isolation, each ethnic group developing its own culture independently

choices_en.text: Flipping your chopsticks (using the opposite end) before picking up food for them
Using your chopsticks to directly pick up food and put it into the other person's bowl
Using your personal spoon to scoop food from the communal dish for them

choices_en.text: A simple, quick lifestyle, adapting to the urbanization development of workers
Dirty, dusty eateries that do not ensure food safety and hygiene
Eateries that only open on windy days with a lot of dust

text_en: On the Nguyên Tiêu Festival (Full Moon of the First Lunar Month), what cultural psychological need does people flocking to pagodas to pray for peace reflect?

choices_en.text: Wishing for peace, relieving anxiety, and praying for a smooth new year for the family
Going to the festival to check-in, take pictures to show off on social media
A mandatory ritual to participate in, otherwise bad luck will come all year

text_en: You want to make a short video introducing the 'áo bà ba' (traditional Southern Vietnamese shirt) and conical hat culture of Southern Vietnamese women. Which of the following settings is most suitable?

choices_en.text: The riverine landscape of the Mekong Delta, floating markets, or vast rice fields with storks flying
The ancient royal palace with mossy walls in Hue
Wooden stilt houses perched precariously on high mountain cliffs in the Northwest

text_en: When a friend gives you a box of Hang Than Green Rice Flakes Cake, what drink should you enjoy with it to make the cultural food experience even better?

choices_en.text: A hot, rich cup of lotus tea
A glass of black sugar boba milk tea
A cold glass of sparkling water

text_en: What is the deep meaning of the proverb "Sell distant relatives, buy close neighbors" in Vietnamese village culture?

choices_en.text: It highlights the importance of neighborly love and timely mutual support in daily life.
It advises people to cut off relationships with distant relatives.
It promotes buying and selling goods with people who live next door.

text_en: When attending a 'hầu đồng' ritual in the Mother Goddess Worship belief, which of the following actions by a spectator is considered culturally appropriate?

choices_en.text: Watching the 'giá đồng' (spirit possession performances) carefully, happily receiving blessings (cakes, fruits, small money) from the medium.
Standing up to snatch and grab the blessing money from the medium's hand while they are dancing.
Sitting and laughing, judging the appearance and clothes of the medium.

text_en: Why did people in old Vietnamese funeral culture often place a bunch of green bananas on the stomach of the deceased before embalming?

choices_en.text: According to folk beliefs, it was to absorb bad energy and keep the body stable.
To provide food for the deceased on their journey so they wouldn't be hungry.
Because a bunch of green bananas was a mandatory decoration in the coffin.

text_en: When you visit a Vietnamese family and see a small altar placed on the ground right at the main entrance, with statues of two 'Ông Địa' (Earth God) and 'Thần Tài' (God of Wealth) on it, what should you be aware of?

choices_en.text: You must not step on or carelessly throw things in front of this altar area.
You can comfortably sit on the altar if there are no other chairs in the house.
Conveniently take candies from the altar to eat to curb your hunger.

text_en: What does it show when some coffee shops nowadays use a bamboo winnowing basket (originally used for sifting rice) as a tray to serve drinks to customers?

choices_en.text: The application and creative adaptation of folk cultural materials into modern service spaces.
A lack of funds to buy modern plastic or stainless steel trays.
Blind imitation that brings no artistic value.

text_en: When attending the Tay Nguyen Gong Festival, you want to try playing the gong with the local people. Which approach shows cultural understanding?

choices_en.text: Ask permission from the village elder or ritual master, and listen to instructions on how to strike the gong to the correct rhythm of the team.
Run in and snatch the gong from the artist's hand and strike it very hard as you please.
Hold two gongs and continuously hit them together to create a loud, joyful sound.

text_en: A friend asks you: Why do Vietnamese people avoid combing their hair or looking in the mirror at night, especially during Tết (Lunar New Year)? How do you explain this from a folk culture perspective?

choices_en.text: It is a folk spiritual taboo to avoid inviting negative energies and bad luck.
Because combing hair at night will cause all hair to fall out and not grow back.
Because at night, the mirror will transform into a different object.

text_en: In a family meeting to discuss renovating the ancestral temple, whose opinion is usually listened to and respected first according to traditional culture?

choices_en.text: The opinion of the clan leader (head of the lineage) or the elders in the family.
The opinion of the youngest child in the family because they are the youngest.
The opinion of the tallest person in the lineage.

text_en: When you take a boat trip on the Perfume River (Hue) to listen to Hue folk songs, which action shows the sophistication of an art appreciator?

choices_en.text: Staying silent when the artists perform, and releasing floating lanterns for peace as instructed.
Turning on your portable speaker to sing karaoke with the artists for fun.
Chatting loudly and having a drinking party right on the boat.

text_en: Why does the boiled rooster on the New Year's Eve offering tray always have a red rose in its beak?

choices_en.text: It means good luck, a good new beginning, and the image of the rooster crowing to call the bright sun.
To hide the scratches on the rooster's beak from boiling.
Because red roses make the chicken meat taste better when eaten.

text_en: When Vietnamese people use the saying 'Everything is difficult at the beginning' to encourage each other when starting something new, what cultural quality does this show?

choices_en.text: The spirit of patience, perseverance, and being ready to face and overcome challenges.
A pessimistic mindset, always thinking about failure before doing something.
Laziness, wanting to give up right from the first steps.

text_en: If you are invited to eat at a foreign friend's house, what should you do to show them the Vietnamese culture of inviting people to eat?

choices_en.text: Explain to them that before eating, Vietnamese people usually invite everyone from the oldest to the youngest to show respect.
Force your foreign friend to stand up and fold their arms to invite people to eat just like you.
Sit quietly and eat normally without saying anything because foreign cultures don't invite people to eat.

text_en: Why did ancient Vietnamese people have the custom of tattooing (especially popular during the Trần Dynasty)?

choices_en.text: To protect themselves when hunting, to avoid being harmed by water monsters, and to show a brave spirit.
To look beautiful according to international fashion trends at that time.
To tell the difference between rich and poor people in society.

text_en: When designing a poster to promote the Hoi An Heritage Tourism Week, which image symbol below gives the highest cultural recognition effect?

choices_en.text: Images of yellow-walled houses with mossy tiled roofs and bright lanterns.
Images of skyscrapers and a modern subway system.
Images of sandy beaches with coconut trees and surfers.

text_en: If you accidentally step on someone's foot in a public place (like on a bus), which response shows the polite behavior of modern Vietnamese culture?

choices_en.text: "I'm sorry, I was careless, are you okay?" with a slight, apologetic smile.
Stay silent and turn your face away as if you had nothing to do with it.
Stare at the other person and blame them for blocking your way.

choices_en.text: Its thin body is flexible, its roots are deep, and it grows in clumps, showing resilience, flexibility, and unity.
Bamboo is easily broken if there's a big storm, showing weakness.

text_en: When watching a Water Puppet show, a child asks you: "Why do the artists stand in the water to perform?" How would you explain it best?

choices_en.text: The water is the stage, it helps hide the strings and poles that control the puppets, and it makes the show lively and sparkling with reflections.
Because the artists like to play in the water to cool off.

text_en: When you visit your girlfriend's/boyfriend's family for Tet, which gift below shows thoughtfulness and understanding of the Tet gift-giving culture?

choices_en.text: A Tet gift basket with tea, cakes, and candies, elegantly packaged.
A set of trendy clothes chosen in a hip-hop style.
A supermarket discount voucher that has already expired.

choices_en.text: To remind people that when they go to a new place, they need to respect and follow the customs and culture of that place.
To advise people to try to change all the customs of the new place they arrive at.
To advise us to only live in our hometown and not go far away.

text_en: When you see a young person wearing revealing, skimpy clothes while going to burn incense at the Ngoc Son Temple historical site, what do you think about this behavior?

choices_en.text: It's behavior that goes against cultural norms, showing disrespect for a sacred place and heritage values.
It's a personal style, showing a person's freedom to dress in modern society.
It's normal behavior, nothing to worry about or criticize.

text_en: In a family, when children achieve high academic results, parents often prepare a meal to offer incense and thank their ancestors. What does this action show?

choices_en.text: The belief that achievements come from the blessings passed down by ancestors and the efforts of their descendants.
Superstition, thinking that ancestors helped their child with the exam.
A show-off action to make neighboring families jealous.

text_en: When you eat Hanoi bun cha, which way of eating shows that you are a connoisseur and understand the culinary culture of the capital?

Pour all the vermicelli and fresh herbs into the dipping sauce bowl and mix it all up like a salad.
Take all the grilled pork out onto a separate plate to eat dry, and leave the dipping sauce bowl behind.

text_en: What is the deepest meaning of organizing the 'Green Banh Chung for the Poor' festival every Tet holiday?

choices_en.text: Sharing love, bringing a warm Tet to difficult circumstances, and promoting the spirit of 'good leaves protect torn leaves'.
Solving the problem of leftover dong leaves and sticky rice in the market.
Creating opportunities for philanthropists to take pictures and promote themselves.

text_en: Why, in traditional Vietnamese culture, do big events like weddings and building houses require checking for a good day and month?

choices_en.text: It shows a desire for peace, hoping that things will go smoothly and well, and it helps relieve psychological stress.
Because the law requires work to be done on good days.

text_en: When a foreigner compliments your ao dai, saying it's very beautiful, which answer shows cultural pride and politeness?

choices_en.text: Thank you very much! The ao dai is a proud traditional outfit of us Vietnamese people.
It's nothing special, everyone in my country wears this kind of shirt.
I know I'm beautiful, you don't need to compliment me.

text_en: What is the purpose of the people in Quat Dong embroidery village always holding an annual ceremony to commemorate the founder of the embroidery craft?

choices_en.text: To honor the ancestors who taught the craft and to educate future generations to preserve the village's craft tradition.
To organize a big feast for entertainment after a year of work.
To find foreign partners to sign purchasing contracts.

choices_en.text: You shouldn't give money directly, but you can donate books, notebooks, or school supplies through schools or local authorities.
Give a lot of small change so the children have money to buy toys freely.

Hold it with one hand and immediately put it in your back pocket without looking.

text_en: When you visit Phong Nha Cave (Quang Binh), which action shows protection of natural and cultural heritage?

To cause traffic jams, creating a crowded atmosphere for the festival

Because the stork has beautiful, elegant white feathers, similar to women's clothing
